policies.title: Ten named ordinary passports: Cambodia advance Tourist Visa T
policies.summary: The live Cambodian Embassy visitor page expressly requires these named ordinary passport holders to obtain an entry visa before departure.
conditions: The named list is Afghanistan, Algeria, Saudi Arabia, Bangladesh, Iran, Iraq, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Sudan and Nigeria. This is an advance-visa classification, not an eVisa or visa-on-arrival finding.

The page was live-rechecked on 22 August 2026, but other sections still contain explicitly transitional 2024 e-Arrival wording and a dated 2023 exemption image. No current dated central nationality schedule was re-openable; retain this named rule at medium confidence and recheck before promotion or travel.

Tourist Visa T is described as single entry, valid for three months from issue, permits a 30-day stay and cannot be used for employment. The page requires a passport valid at least six months after departure from Cambodia; issuance and admission remain discretionary.

This ordinary-passport visitor finding does not establish Visa E/business, residence, extensions, repeated entry, transit, diplomatic, official, service, courtesy, K-visa/Khmer-origin, refugee, alien or other special-document treatment.

policies.title: Cambodia: expressly supported residual ordinary-passport Tourist Visa T on arrival
policies.summary: For the currently unsupported ordinary-passport cohort below, Cambodia's current official Embassy guidance establishes issuance of a visitor visa directly on arrival rather than relying on eVisa-portal universality.
conditions: The Embassy page says a traveler without an entry visa can obtain the visa directly on arrival, which establishes issuance timing at the airport, listed land posts or listed sea ports; the live GDI e-Arrival service also identifies Electronic Visa On Arrival as a current service component. This is not an inference from an eVisa selector or application portal.

The same Embassy page expressly requires Afghanistan, Algeria, Saudi Arabia, Bangladesh, Iran, Iraq, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Sudan and Nigeria to obtain a visa before departure. Those ten passports are excluded from this residual cohort and are assigned by the carried prior-visa policy.

The Embassy page was live-rechecked on 22 August 2026 but contains other stale material, including explicitly transitional 2024 e-Arrival wording and a 2023 exemption image. Neither live GDI nor re-openable MFA/eVisa material supplied a current exhaustive nationality schedule; this confined residual cohort remains medium confidence and requires rechecking.

The traveler must present a passport valid at least six months, a return or onward ticket and a recent photograph, and complete the form on site. Some carriers may require an entry visa before boarding.

This is a Tourist Visa T visitor-route finding only. It does not establish work, residence, extensions, repeated-entry, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, alien or other special-document treatment.

The GDI arrival service corroborates the current existence of electronic VOA processing but does not by itself establish nationality eligibility. Cambodia e-Arrival is not classified as an ETA; admission remains subject to Cambodian immigration and carrier requirements.
